description: This file contains C++ source code for unit testing the RDM JSON functionalities using Google Test and Google Mock. It defines a mock class for JSON-related methods, sets up various test cases to validate JSON parsing, length retrieval, and querying operations related to a JSON manifest structure, particularly focusing on 'apps' data and error handling.

classes.name: MockRdmJson
classes.description: Mock class for JSON-related methods such as retrieving length, querying data, and extracting application details.

classes.name: RdmJsonTest
classes.description: Test fixture class using Google Test framework, includes setup and teardown for JSON file handling and multiple test cases for different JSON operations.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes a sample JSON manifest file before each test case.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Removes the temporary JSON manifest file after each test case.
